title: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/${branch}
description: The default branch, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:controls) for protection.enabled, true where the branch has a protection of its own, as every reader may see; protected is also true where a ruleset guards it, checked live on empowerite/kit. The types are those of GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch} in GitHub's REST OpenAPI, as https://docs.github.com/rest/branches/branches#get-a-branch describes them.
